changes.before: Medium shot in a modest London room on the morning of 2 September 1666, one adult English man in his thirties with mature facial features and dark hair pulls on a plain dark wool cloak over a linen shirt beside a wooden doorway, soft grey daylight
changes.after: Medium close-up cropped above the waist inside a plain London room on the morning of 2 September 1666: one adult English man in his thirties with a mature face and dark hair actively lifts a plain unfastened dark wool cloak over both shoulders, both hands drawing its loose front edges toward his chest. He wears a loose off-white linen shirt with an open plain collar. Bare plaster wall and simple wooden doorway only, soft grey daylight; no bottles, jars, necktie, striped shirt, belt, or modern objects
